I will plant wheat on this small plot the way I can manage with my household. I will use some chemical fertilizer because wheat needs it and in Oromia we often try to get DAP and urea through the cooperative, but I cannot afford a very high amount. I will also use manure if I have enough, keep using local seed because improved seed is hard to get, and I will not irrigate because I depend on the rains. I expect my family to do most of the work, and I may hire a little labor if we are busy at planting or weeding.
